a.lede: The PHP Foundation has revealed two serious vulnerabilities that could impact millions of websites. Security experts warn that failure to quickly patch the flaws could have dire consequences.
a.title: ‘This Is Not a Drill’: Critical PHP Vulnerabilities Are Setting the Internet on Fire

b.title: Amazon says PHP2Shell exploitation began 4 days before patches
